verdict.rationale: GitHub offers cloud-based development environments that launch in seconds (github-docs-3). Copilot cloud agent makes its changes on a separate branch that you review before opening a pull request (github-docs-26), and GitHub Actions can run CI workflows (github-docs-38, github-docs-11). Together these imply an isolated place to test agent work, but nothing in the evidence describes a sandbox that is explicitly separated from production data. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox or test-environment documentation, guarantees of isolation from production data or secrets, test or staging environment controls for agents, and hands-on corroboration.
